The '''Omniscan 3''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|scanner]] integrated into helmets and produced by [[CryonCorp/Legends|CryonCorp]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It cost 1,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="DC" />
